tools.description: List the user's Dictate recordings (meetings, calls, videos, files), newest first, with id, date, duration, source, how many action items are still open and the start of the summary. Optionally filter by date or by words in the title, summary or transcript.

from.description: Only recordings on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the title, summary or transcript (case and diacritics ignored).

to.description: Only recordings on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.title: List recordings

tools.description: Get one recording's details: date, duration, source, the full AI summary (overview, key points, decisions, action items, open questions, timeline) and which action items the user has ticked off. Use get_transcript for what was actually said.

id.description: Recording id from list_meetings or search_meetings, or its exact title.

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.title: Get recording summary

tools.description: Get a recording's transcript as "[mm:ss] Speaker: text" paragraphs, optionally only between two timestamps. Long transcripts come in parts: when the reply says it was cut, call again with the offset it gives.

offset.description: Skip this many paragraphs (to continue a cut reply).

start.description: Only from this time on, e.g. "12:30" or "1:05:00".

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.title: Get recording transcript

tools.description: Search all recordings' titles, summaries and transcripts for words (all must appear in the same paragraph or line; case and diacritics ignored, so "hop" finds "họp"). Returns matching snippets with their recording id and [mm:ss] time.
tools.name: search_meetings
tools.title: Search recordings

tools.description: List the action items from the recordings' summaries, with owner, recording and whether the user has ticked them off in Dictate. Defaults to the open ones.

from.description: Only recordings on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

owner.description: Only items whose owner contains these words.

to.description: Only recordings on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: list_action_items
tools.title: List action items
